_comment: This is a 4x4 homogeneous transformation matrix in the format:

_explanation.R (3x3 upper-left): Rotation matrix - must be orthonormal (columns/rows are unit vectors, perpendicular to each other)
_explanation.t (3x1 rightmost column): Translation vector [tx, ty, tz] in millimeters

_examples.identity: No rotation or translation - meshes already aligned
_examples.translation_only: Move quest mesh 100mm in X direction (tx=100), as shown above

rotation_and_translation.description: Rotate 90 degrees around Z + translate [100, 50, -25] mm

_note: The 'transform' key can also be omitted and the array provided directly at the root level
